title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings: reproducibility artifact
description:
Code, frozen derived inputs, results and the six-page author manuscript for When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings, prepared for ESANN 2027 (not a proceedings publication or an acceptance claim).

The artifact implements exact finite-batch F1 intervals after disagreement labeling, epsilon-best minimax decisions with absolute tolerance 0.01, and a paired-versus-marginal interval comparison. It includes 36 dependent benchmark cells, 3,200 pairs, three query policies and 32 orders, validation-only comparator selection, mathematical checks, provenance manifests and table-generation scripts. The extensions are retrospective. Fixed-prevalence results specialize TDC and partial-identification frameworks.

Artifact 1.0.0 corresponds to manuscript V3.1. The update from independently AI-reviewed V3 changes only the availability sentence and release documentation; all scientific code, frozen inputs and results are unchanged. No original feature tables or other manuscripts are included. Software: BSD-3-Clause. Article text: CC BY 4.0. The ESANN template retains its original license. See README.rst and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.
